name: Kvant-2
about: Kvant-2 (1989-093A), a crewed vehicle (TsM), launched 1989 Nov 26. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1989 Dec 26), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
